deviations: Centralized, full-model method mapped onto a LoRA-factor server view: the paper unlearns a poisoned LLM whose weights it holds, while the aggregate view exposes LoRA factors only, so the poisoned student can only be the round's aggregated LoRA; poison baked into the base weights is invisible to every view in this library

The paper's output (a model) maps to the replace_global action at SERVER_POST_AGGREGATE, which does exist (ACTION_STAGES, core/actions.py, OpenFedLLMGuard.after_aggregate) -- but the plugin cannot compute the state to pass to it

Pipeline steps 1-2 (the dimension-alignment layer g and the teacher's full-parameter fine-tuning) are offline preparation of a separate model, so they are resources and not plugin work (rule 3); they are the only two steps outside the plugin

The paper's evaluation (CA/ASR) and its information-bottleneck corollary (eq. 15) produce no runtime action, and the method produces no per-client score, exclusion or weight -- the library's Decision has no counterpart here
The paper needs no client/server round trip and reads nothing client-side; this port declares no client-side plugin, and the two 'sides' of the paper collapse onto the server
